title: PMVECs treated with vehicle rep 1
characteristics_ch1: cell type: pulmonary microvascular endothelial cells
treatment_protocol_ch1: Cells were treated with freshly prepared heme (5 micromolar), every 48 hours for seven days
growth_protocol_ch1: Endothelial cells were grown in complete medium containing fetal calf serum at 37 degrees celcius
extract_protocol_ch1: Trizol extraction of total RNA was performed according to the manufacturer's instructions.
label_protocol_ch1: Biotinylated cRNA were prepared according to the standard Affymetrix protocol from 6 ug total RNA.
hyb_protocol: Following fragmentation, 10 ug of cRNA were hybridized for 16 hr at 45C on a Human U 133 plus 2.0 GeneChip Array. GeneChips were washed and stained in the Affymetrix Fluidics Station 400.
scan_protocol: GeneChips were scanned using the Hewlett-Packard GeneArray Scanner G2500A.
description: Gene expression data of PMVECs cultured for seven days in normal medium
data_processing: Gene level expression index was generated using the Affymetrix MAS 5.0 software.
